prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Aurelio Vane. Character visual motifs: masked fencing host in ceremonial midnight tux-armor with luminous floorwork slippers and half-moon fan shield.
TOP LEFT: Perfect Partner. Ability concept: an ally who follows an Aurelio-created floor arrow gains brief tenacity, once / ally / 6 s.
TOP RIGHT: Mark the Floor. Ability concept: lays two 30-GU glowing steps; an ally crossing them in order gains 22% movement speed for 1.5 s. Enemies see the steps and can deny the route.
BOTTOM LEFT: Change Partners. Ability concept: selects an allied hero in 120 GU; for 1.2 s both can voluntarily trade their places by pressing an interaction or by an AI commitment. Cannot trade into walls or out of hard CC.
BOTTOM RIGHT: The Grand Procession. Ability concept: reveals a three-turn floor route for 4 s. Allies following it earn a small shield at each turn; enemies who stand on the route are pushed sideways 18 GU once when the procession advances. No AoE charm or automatic ally dash.
